# Japanese loanwords from German
# Source: https://www.sljfaq.org/afaq/german.html ("Which Japanese words come from German?", sci.lang.japan FAQ by Ben Bullock)
# Fetched: 2026-09-21 (single web_fetch, HTTP 200, page content complete/not truncated)
# Entries: 87
# Format: german_word:katakana  (german word lowercased ASCII, diacritics folded a/o/u/ss, spaces/hyphens/apostrophes/parens removed; katakana copied verbatim from the page)
# Note: for the "ゼミ・ゼミナール" row only the ・-free form ゼミナール is used, because the format allows katakana and ー only.
# Note: the page lists both メルヘン and メルヘンティック for "Märchen"; the derived duplicate key marchen is kept once (メルヘン).
# Note: the page's ピッケル row has an empty "German" cell with "Pickel" in the following column; read as German "Pickel" -> pickel.
